items.caption:
Jensen Huang says an AI agent now does in about three minutes the research that used to take him four to eight hours on a weekend.
On a Washington panel with Elon Musk, the Nvidia CEO describes hitting Enter and getting back a finished report.
Source: RSBN, Elon Musk, Jensen Huang, Tom Brown Discuss the AI Revolution. Full video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=388P7IFSpwE

Sam Altman says using the latest AI tools feels like managing a factory inside his computer.
On stage at Oracle AI World with Oracle co-CEO Clay Magouyrk, he says the work he does not enjoy now gets automated.
